comparison.objective: Activate a handheld 3D scanner and cover at least 95% of a cast housing's outer surface, including its top; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2016 tests button actuation, scanner handling at valid standoff and view angle, turntable coordination, occlusion planning, and tracking recovery. The candidate tests coaxial hand-tool use, countertorque, wrench regrasping, and mechanical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2016 requires 95% scan coverage, top coverage, final clearance, and no part disturbance, scanner collision, or drop. The candidate requires a retained 90° opening through three cycles with bounded drift and retained hardware. No material rubric details are missing; scanner facing and tracking limits are explicitly labeled assumptions.
comparison.reason: Surface-view planning and noncontact inspection do not establish overlap with two-tool mechanical adjustment, locknut reaction control, or functional retention testing.
